title: Borean Tundra
body: The Borean Tundra is the western gateway to Northrend, a wide land of frozen bog, steaming geysers and pale grass under thin snow, and here the war against the Lich King comes ashore. The Alliance holds Valiance Keep on the southern coast and the Horde's Warsong Offensive has raised Warsong Hold in the west, and both are hard pressed by Nerubians tunneling beneath their walls and a Scourge host on the plains. On the isle of Coldarra the blue dragonflight wages a war of its own over the world's magic.

title: Valiance Keep
body: Valiance Keep is the Alliance's port in the Borean Tundra, where ships from Stormwind unload soldiers for the war on the Lich King. General Arlos commands with Counselor Talbot at his side, and a statue honors King Varian Wrynn, the returned king whose valor the Alliance carries north. The keep is besieged by undead Nerubians from the ridges, and behind it the farming village of Farshire burns, overrun by the Scourge.

parts.body: Cultists of the Cult of the Damned have slipped inside, at work on the docks, in the jail and in the inn's kitchen, and Farshire's soldiers were betrayed by plagued grain.

parts.body: The rot reached higher than anyone feared. Counselor Talbot was Prince Valanar of the San'layn, reporting to the Lich King that the cult's grip on the Alliance's leaders was well underway.

title: Warsong Hold
body: Warsong Hold is the Horde's fortress on the tundra's western coast, base of the Warsong Offensive and the start of its road to Icecrown. Its Overlord, Garrosh Hellscream, greets newcomers by sniffing the air for their fear, and beside him stands High Overlord Saurfang; the two quarrel openly, Saurfang counting supply lines and siege engines while Garrosh answers that the Horde needs nothing but its warrior spirit.

parts.body: On the Plains of Nasam a thousand Scourge and four great death machines massed against the hold, and the tanks that broke them learned who led the host: Kel'Thuzad. If he commands, Naxxramas has returned.

title: High Overlord Varok Saurfang
body: High Overlord Varok Saurfang is an old warrior of the Horde who drank Mannoroth's blood with the rest of his people and remembers all too well what they did under its curse. Now he stands at Garrosh Hellscream's side in Warsong Hold, the voice of caution against the young Overlord's impatience. Fear, he says, has always been the orcs' greatest weapon, and now they face an enemy that knows none.

parts.body: He has told Garrosh plainly that he will not let him lead the Horde down that dark path again, even if he must kill him himself.
sources: npc_text 12381 (fear our greatest weapon)

parts.body: The carapace of a great Nerubian reminded him of Silithus, where the Might of Kalimdor trampled a thousand bugs like it in the desert. This land is different, he said, but the result will be the same.
sources: npc_text 12381 (fear our greatest weapon)

parts.body: His son's battle armor was carried to him from the Wrathgate. Like Brox, the old orc said, his son died a hero, and for an orc there could be no better end.

title: Riplash
body: Riplash, on the southern coast, was a city of the naga, and the strand below it is now the main base of the Kvaldir in the tundra: giant raiders who took the city from its people, drew their longboats up on the beach and hold tuskarr captives among the ruins. At a shrine on the western shore they have kept one naga priestess alive, and on the bluffs above hides a young tuskarr survivor of a village they burned.

parts.body: The Kvaldir came to wake Leviroth, a being Queen Azshara imprisoned in the waters beneath Riplash five hundred years ago, and fed it the naga, then the tuskarr.
sources: quest 11662 description (main base of the Kvaldir, Karuk on the bluffs)

parts.body: Azshara blessed a golden trident for the emperor of Riplash to slay the beast should it ever escape. Taken from the Kvaldir captain, it killed Leviroth.

title: Kaskala
body: Kaskala is a tuskarr village on the coast northeast of Valiance Keep, a sacred place to which, its people say, the spirit Tayutka herself guided their ancestors. Now the Kvaldir come at it out of the mist without provocation, and its families have gone east to the harbor town of Unu'pe, while the old shaman refuses to leave the altar of Tayutka: if they do not abandon the spirits, he says, the spirits will not abandon them.

parts.body: Blue and white platforms set mage hunters down on the quarry to murder the craftsmen in the middle of their rites and plunder it for artifacts.

title: Coldarra
body: Coldarra is an island of ice and arcane light in the northwest of the tundra, and from a vast trench at its heart rises the Nexus, fortress of Malygos and his blue dragonflight. Hidden beneath a shield nearby, Kirin Tor mages and red dragons watch the enemy, their supply lines cut. To the south, at Amber Ledge, the Kirin Tor investigate why mages all across Azeroth are being abducted, and the earthquakes in the rift have grown alarmingly frequent.

parts.body: Magic seeping from Coldarra has driven the murlocs of the Westrift mad, and their unusual king fears the Nexus War between the blue dragonflight and the other dragons is spilling over.

title: Malygos
body: Malygos is the Aspect of Magic and master of the blue dragonflight, and the Nexus is his fortress. Deathwing's betrayal long ago all but destroyed his flight and wounded his mind. Now he has decided that mortals tap the world's arcane energies so carelessly that Azeroth will be annihilated, and he draws magic toward the Nexus while his servants hunt down mages. The red dragons and the Kirin Tor have gone to war against him.

parts.body: Hidden instruments show him channeling far too much power into Coldarra, while reports of instability arrive from all over Azeroth: if he is not stopped, Azeroth will be the next Outland.
sources: npc_text 12590 (Raelorasz: magic, irresponsible mortals, council, Malygos's plan)

parts.body: When his consort Saragosa was slain, the red dragon Keristrasza called him out. He came, claimed her to take Saragosa's place, and when she refused him, he took her.

title: Fizzcrank Airstrip
body: Fizzcrank Airstrip is the Alliance's forward airbase in the north of the tundra, built in great haste by gnomish flying daredevils. East of it the earth steams in the Geyser Fields, and the pumping station the gnomes built there has gone silent: robots tramp through the muck, and strange mechanical gnomes appeared not long after the station's own gnomes vanished.

parts.body: The station's pipe had clogged on Gearmaster Mechazod, a broken gnome-shaped robot who claimed to be among the first gnomes made by a keeper of the titans, and who cured the gnomes of what he calls the curse of flesh.

title: Taunka'le Village
body: Taunka'le Village has been the home of the taunka of the tundra for generations, a people of winter kin to the tauren. Chieftain Wintergale leads them, his counselors pulling him two ways, and the Scourge has the village surrounded: many have already gone east toward Icemist, their capital in the Dragonblight. North of it a Scourge necropolis fell from the sky and broke upon the ground beside the caves where the magnataur go to die.

parts.body: Taunka'le was abandoned at last. Wintergale stayed to defend it, and at the gate an old mother wept: once the snow filled the tundra; now it has left them, a sign that their time here is over.

title: Temple City of En'kilah
body: The Temple City of En'kilah, in the northeast, is the Scourge's seat in the Borean Tundra, a plagued Nerubian city with the necropolis Naxxanar floating above it. Three spires rise from its grounds, each kept by a high priest, and the darkfallen of the San'layn move among the crypt fiends. To the south stands the Wailing Ziggurat, which a dozen Alliance men were sent to storm.

parts.body: Inside the Spire of Blood the Scourge bleeds its prisoners alive and carries the blood up to the necropolis to feed a blood prince.
sources: quest 11628 description (seat of the Scourge, commander, Nerubians, blighted land)

parts.body: At the summit of Naxxanar waited Prince Valanar of the San'layn, who commands the Scourge in the tundra, and there he was defeated.
